import ctypes
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import select
import signal
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time


def probe(uid, gid):
    libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
    libc.prctl.argtypes = [ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong, ctypes.c_ulong]
    libc.prctl.restype = ctypes.c_int
    if libc.prctl(36, 1, 0, 0, 0) != 0:
        raise OSError(ctypes.get_errno(), 'PR_SET_CHILD_SUBREAPER failed')

    group = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='codex-scheduler-probe-', dir='/sys/fs/cgroup'))
    root = None
    adopted_exits = {}
    try:
        leaf_source = (
            "import json,os,time; "
            "print(json.dumps({'pid':os.getpid(),'uid':os.getuid(),"
            "'group':os.getpgrp(),'membership':open('/proc/self/cgroup').read()}),flush=True); "
            "time.sleep(60)"
        )
        root_source = (
            "import os,subprocess,sys; sys.stdin.readline(); "
            "subprocess.Popen([sys.executable,'-u','-c',sys.argv[1]],start_new_session=True); "
            "os._exit(7)"
        )
        root = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, '-u', '-c', root_source, leaf_source],
                                stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
                                user=uid, group=gid, extra_groups=[])
        (group / 'cgroup.procs').write_text(str(root.pid))
        assert root.pid in [int(value) for value in (group / 'cgroup.procs').read_text().split()]
        root.stdin.write(b'go\n')
        root.stdin.flush()
        assert root.wait(timeout=10) == 7
        assert select.select([root.stdout], [], [], 10)[0], 'Detached child did not report readiness'
        leaf = json.loads(root.stdout.readline())
        assert leaf['uid'] == uid, leaf
        assert leaf['group'] == leaf['pid'], leaf
        assert f'/{group.name}\n' in leaf['membership'], leaf
        assert 'populated 1\n' in (group / 'cgroup.events').read_text()
        members = [int(value) for value in (group / 'cgroup.procs').read_text().split()]
        assert leaf['pid'] in members, members
        print(json.dumps({'event': 'detached_child_retained', 'root_exit': root.returncode,
                          'cgroup': str(group), 'members': members, 'leaf': leaf}), flush=True)

        (group / 'cgroup.kill').write_text('1\n')
        deadline = time.monotonic_ns() + 5_000_000_000
        while 'populated 1\n' in (group / 'cgroup.events').read_text():
            assert time.monotonic_ns() < deadline, 'Owned cgroup retained live processes after kill'
            time.sleep(.01)
        adopted_pid, status = os.waitpid(leaf['pid'], 0)
        adopted_exits[adopted_pid] = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
        assert adopted_exits[leaf['pid']] == -signal.SIGKILL
        stdout, stderr = root.communicate(timeout=5)
        assert (stdout, stderr) == (b'', b''), (stdout, stderr)
        print(json.dumps({'event': 'cgroup_candidate_passed', 'root_exit': root.returncode,
                          'adopted_exits': adopted_exits,
                          'events': (group / 'cgroup.events').read_text()}), flush=True)
    finally:
        (group / 'cgroup.kill').write_text('1\n')
        if root is not None:
            if root.poll() is None:
                root.kill()
            root.communicate(timeout=5)
        while True:
            try:
                pid, status = os.waitpid(-1, 0)
                adopted_exits[pid] = os.waitstatus_to_exitcode(status)
            except ChildProcessError:
                break
        group.rmdir()
        print(json.dumps({'event': 'owned_cgroup_removed', 'path': str(group),
                          'exists': group.exists(), 'adopted_exits': adopted_exits}), flush=True)


probe(int(sys.argv[1]), int(sys.argv[2]))
